laws.rule: Rodna Mountains National Park: visit fee 5 lei per person per day (price list applicable from 1 January 2018, the latest the park publishes). (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 5 lei ≈ A$1.49)
laws.heading: Rodna Mountains National Park

laws.rule: Călimani National Park: access ticket 10 lei per person per day (5 lei pupils and students); compulsory on entering the park. Guided packages include it. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 10 lei ≈ A$2.98)
laws.heading: Călimani National Park
